messages:
samir: hey @channel quick eyes pls — PR #7605 is failing CI on smoke/kv_cache.test, looks flaky. can someone grab? failing on our dedicated runner.
ci-bot: CI failed for PR #7605 — job smoke-tests (runner:gpu-dedicated-03) — smoke/kv_cache.test timed out after 300s. build: https://ci.redwood.example/12345
tara: i'll take a look in a few mins :eyes: 
priya: log snippet points to timeout waiting on kv get: see below
```
ERROR: timeout waiting for kv response
stack: net::ReadTimeout at kv_client.go:198
``` 
kevin: could be the test harness not stubbing latency. i can reproduce locally with `make smoke` — adding debug prints now
samir: thanks @kevin. if it's a test harness fix we can land quickly, otherwise we should revert the change in PR that touched kv client
kevin: pushed a small test-fix branch and reran smoke locally, passed 5/5. i'll drop the change into the PR as an additional commit
matthew: quick tip — if it's nondet add `t.Parallel()` guard or increase timeout to 600s for now, but prefer deterministic fix
kevin: pushed commit 3f2a1b7, requesting a CI re-run
ci-bot: Re-run requested by kevin — build 12346 queued
ci-bot: Build 12346 passed — all smoke tests green :tada:
samir: awesome, thanks all. i'll merge once the branch protection check passes
tara: merged and cut a changelog entry. moving this to done :white_check_mark:
